questions.stem: A 2700-g male infant, born at 36 weeks gestation, presents at 6 hours of age with grunting, nasal flaring, and intercostal retractions. He is also experiencing poor feeding. His temperature is 35.8°C, and blood pressure is 42 mm Hg systolic. A CBC shows a WBC count of 2500 cells/mm3 with 80% bands. What is the most likely diagnosis?
